info.title: PokeChampions Helper
info.whoBody: We are Pokémon fans who build small, practical tools for players. PokeChampions Helper is our way of making team information easier to read and use during prep and between games.
info.whyBody: Battle and team-preview screens show a lot at once. We wanted a workflow where a screenshot or export becomes clear, structured data—types, stats, moves—without constantly jumping between wikis and calculators.
info.audienceBody: Competitive and casual players alike: anyone who uses team previews or online battles and wants a quicker read on both sides before or after a match.
info.developerCredit: This app is developed by @unaisdev (@unaicanales on Instagram).
info.collaboratorCredit: Collaboration: @elhortelanoo — same handle on Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.
info.disclaimerBody:
Pokémon, character names, and related trademarks are owned by Nintendo, Game Freak, and The Pokémon Company. This app is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

In-game data is loaded from PokéAPI, a community-maintained REST API (not affiliated with The Pokémon Company). If you use Google Gemini with the prompt we provide, that processing happens under Google’s services and terms; this app does not upload your screenshots to our own servers.

battle.lead: Import the JSON you generate in Gemini from your game screenshot. The app shows both teams like the battle screen, with PokéAPI data for each Pokémon.
battle.heroExampleCaption: Example image for Gemini (your team on the left, rival on the right):
battle.heroExampleA11y: Example battle preview screen with two columns of Pokémon
battle.emptyHint: No teams yet. Tap «Import JSON» and paste Gemini’s response.
battle.geminiStep1: 1) Tap «Copy prompt» (instructions + format Gemini must follow).
battle.geminiStep2: 2) «Open Gemini», attach the team screenshot and paste the prompt in the chat.
battle.geminiExampleCaption: Example image type (our team left / rival right):
battle.geminiStep3: 3) When Gemini replies, copy only the JSON and paste it below; tap «Apply».

changePokemon.title: Change Pokémon
changePokemon.hint: If PokéAPI lists several forms, pick one below. To use a different Pokémon, use the search.
changePokemon.searchHint: English name or PokéAPI slug (e.g. charizard, palafin-hero).
changePokemon.searchEmpty: Enter a PokéAPI name or slug.

card.statsInfoA11y: About base stats and range at Lv. {{level}}
card.statsInfoBody:
Top: base stats.

Bottom: stat range at Lv. {{level}}.
• Minimum: minimum EVs and a hindering nature.
• Maximum: maximum EVs and a boosting nature.
card.compareStatsA11y: Compare base stats with the other team

compareModal.title: Compare base stats
compareModal.hint: PokéAPI base stats. Each row: upper bar = base on the shared scale; lower track = possible in-battle values at the level below (IV/EV spread; non-HP uses hindering/boosting nature), like the team cards. Higher base wins the row highlight. BST is the sum of base stats.
compareModal.statsCaption: Upper track: base stat. Lower track: battle range at Lv. {{level}} (same rules as the cards).
compareModal.noSelectableOpponent: No Pokémon on the other team have finished loading. Wait for PokéAPI or fix import errors.

movesModal.title: Moves · {{name}}
movesModal.hint: Details load when you open this list (not when loading the team). Filter by type and category once loaded.
